messages:
jade: Starting a short thread to capture governance + listing readiness for VoltScale. Primary goals: cloud artifact parity (AMI / GCR / ACR), SKU entitlements, export controls, and a joint announcement timeline. Who owns the asset manifest ingest?

marie: I'll own the ingest and packaging. Need the final AMI IDs and container digests. Also request VoltScale provide a single CSV with SKU metadata (sku_id, sku_name, price_point, trial_eligibility).

volt-ops: Working on the CSV now. AMI bake ETA 36h, container images pushed to staging registries today. We'll include an export-control attestation and firmware SHA in the package.

oliver: Product asks that the marketplace listing expose two purchase flows: self-serve hosted API and an enterprise-dedicated path. For the dedicated SKU, include an optional seat + instance combo. I'll draft a mapping doc linking SKU -> billing_meter_code -> trial_flag.

ana (Legal): Legal note: we need partner-provided trademark usage terms and a short indemnity paragraph for the hardware acceleration. Also ask VoltScale whether customer logs or metrics are sent back to them. If so, we need to document data processing and add clauses to the DPA.

jade: VoltScale, can you confirm telemetry practices?

volt-ops: VoltScale telemetry: only aggregated usage stats for capacity planning, no PII. We'll provide a telemetry spec and opt-out instructions.

partnerships-bot: Reminder: new marketplace schema requires asset manifest JSON v3. See /doc/marketplace/schema-v3.

marie: Quick checklist I'll run through: (1) asset manifest v3, (2) AMI/GCR/ACR IDs + digests, (3) SKU CSV + pricing, (4) legal artifacts (EULA/DPA/brand use), (5) announcement copy. Post links once uploaded.

oliver: Can we schedule a 30min sync tomorrow 11:00am PT to review the manifest + pricing?

jade: 11:00 works. Please bring the draft SKU CSV and a sample listing page mock.

ana (Legal): I'll review EULA + DPA drafts before the call. Sending inline comments to the shared doc this evening.

volt-ops: Noted. We'll upload AMI IDs and container manifest to the shared folder and ping here when ready.

marie: Action items: marie -> manifest + packaging; oliver -> SKU mapping + listing mock; ana -> legal review; volt-ops -> artifacts + attestation. I'll create the meeting and pre-read in the calendar.

jade: Thanks team. Short, focused call tomorrow and then we can open the publisher onboarding ticket. :rocket:
